Class TypeaheadController

java.lang.Object
org.patternfly.component.typeahead.TypeaheadController
public class TypeaheadController extends Object
Manages typeahead input handling state. Encapsulates the refresh strategy, search filter, no-results handler, and the input logic driven by RefreshStrategy and Decision.

On each input change, the controller evaluates the strategy to get a Decision:

  • Decision.Action.REFRESH — re-query the server immediately via Menu.refresh()
  • Decision.Action.DEBOUNCE — re-query the server after a debounce timeout
  • Decision.Action.FILTER — filter existing items locally via Menu.search(SearchFilter, NoResults, String)
  • Decision.Action.KEEP — do nothing, keep the current menu state as-is

The controller delegates component-specific behavior through two callbacks:

  • afterRefresh — called after Menu.refresh() completes (e.g., update hints, fire loaded handlers)
  • onSearch — called instead of Menu.search(SearchFilter, NoResults, String) to allow additional behavior like hint updates
